scope: All 25 published rows and all five visible columns; 23 fish identities rechecked.
limits: Audit complete does not mean every field is confirmed on the Forever server. Exact Forever skill thresholds remain unverified.
Classic loot and pool guides corroborate catch locations and habitat for all 22 Classic fish; Whimsyfin uses a Forever community guide.
ForeverDB Fishing Bobber source records aggregate observations and expose a representative location. Their counts are not counts at that one location and do not establish all catch locations.
Riverglades is absent from the current published fishing-zone dataset. Trout and Greater Sagefish source records expose Stranglethorn locations, which do not verify or disprove Riverglades catches.
Catch types name the freshwater oases/dungeon pools or Whimsyfin pools directly; Sagefish rows identify their schools explicitly.
